facts.claim: An ANA Airbus A321-200N, registration JA145A, was performing flight NH-299 from Tokyo Haneda to Tottori.
On approach to Tottori, the crew aborted the descent at 6,000 feet and entered a hold due to a technical problem.
The crew diverted to Osaka Kansai, where the aircraft landed safely on runway 06 about one hour after stopping the descent at Tottori.
Emergency services found an engine (PW1130G) oil leak, the runway needed to be cleaned, and the aircraft was still on the ground in Osaka about five hours after landing.

zh.title: 全日空A321neo飛往鳥取途中因技術問題中斷下降，轉降大阪關西後發現發動機漏油
zh.summary: 全日空A321neo執行NH-299航班由東京羽田飛往鳥取時，因技術問題在6000呎中斷下降並等待，隨後轉降大阪關西並安全降落06跑道；地面檢查發現發動機PW1130G漏油，跑道需要清理，飛機落地約5小時後仍停留在大阪。
body: 全日空一架空中巴士A321neo、註冊編號JA145A，執行NH-299航班由東京羽田飛往鳥取，在進場鳥取時因技術問題於6000呎中斷下降並進入等待。機組隨後決定轉降大阪關西，約在中斷下降1小時後安全降落06跑道。
落地後的地面檢查發現發動機PW1130G漏油，跑道需要清理。報導指出，飛機在落地約5小時後仍停留在大阪，未進一步說明漏油原因或後續處置。

en.title: ANA A321neo diverts to Osaka Kansai after technical problem on approach to Tottori
en.summary: An ANA Airbus A321neo operating flight NH-299 from Tokyo Haneda to Tottori aborted its descent at 6,000 feet and held due to a technical problem, then diverted to Osaka Kansai and landed safely on runway 06 about one hour later; an engine oil leak was found on the ground and the runway needed cleaning.
body: An ANA All Nippon Airways Airbus A321-200N, registration JA145A, performing flight NH-299 from Tokyo Haneda to Tottori, was on approach to Tottori when the crew aborted the descent at 6,000 feet and entered a hold due to a technical problem. The crew subsequently decided to divert to Osaka Kansai, where the aircraft landed safely on runway 06 about one hour after stopping the descent at Tottori.

Emergency services found an engine (PW1130G) oil leak, and the runway needed to be cleaned. The aircraft was still on the ground in Osaka about five hours after landing, according to the report, which gives no further detail on the cause of the leak or the next steps for the aircraft.
